title: Path of Exile 2
scalpelSetup_required: Scalpel needs first-time setup. Open it, complete onboarding and select PoE 2. With automatic startup enabled, Launch opens Scalpel first and waits for you to return.
scalpelSetup_ready: Scalpel setup is complete · PoE 2 selected.
scalpelSetup_wrong_game: Scalpel is set to PoE 1. Open Scalpel, switch to PoE 2 and let it restart if requested, then launch the game.
scalpelSetup_unknown: Scalpel settings could not be read. Open Scalpel and check its setup before playing. Automatic startup will wait until setup can be verified.
scalpelMissingHint: Scalpel is optional and is not available. Install it under Tools to enable price checking; PoE 2 can launch without it.
profileHint: Choose original rendering or FSR4 upscaling.
closeFirst: Exit the game and fully exit Steam before changing profiles or graphics preferences.
checkFailed: Update check failed. Check your connection and try again.
managedHint: Downloads a verified copy for your user. Existing system packages are left intact.
networkHint: Checks and downloads contact the official GitHub repositories only when requested.
qualityHint: FSR4 scaling preset. Balanced and Performance reduce the rendering workload.
watermarkHint: Use temporarily to confirm FSR4 rather than FSR3 fallback.
diagnosticsHint: Info-level logs only; per-frame tracing stays off.
fgHint: Frame generation is disabled for a consistent first test.
gpuHint: The FSR4 preset targets AMD RDNA2/3 INT8. Speed and compatibility depend on your GPU, Mesa and Proton.
error: Could not read the addon response.
autoScalpelHint: Open your companion before the game starts.
shortcutCaptureHint: Press one key. Esc cancels. Nothing changes until you accept.
shortcutConfirmHint: Accept this key, or try another. The current shortcut is still active.
shortcutSingleKey: Choose a single key without Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Super.
shortcutUnsupported: Use a letter, number, F1–F24, navigation key, or §. This key cannot be mapped reliably.
shortcutHint: Choose a key to open the OptiScaler menu. § uses the Swedish layout mapping. Changes apply on the next game launch.
repairCloseGame:
1. Exit PoE 2.
2. Fully exit Steam.
3. Repair your %1 profile here.
repairCloseSteam:
1. Exit Steam using the button below.
2. When Steam has closed, select Repair %1 profile here.
repairReady: Steam is closed. Select Repair %1 profile below, then launch the game once repair finishes.
repairLocalHint: Uses your saved files without a download. Keeps your selected rendering profile and preferences.
